name: Argent Arbiter
summary: An Argent Dawn scout may be the remains you found, but no other Skyborne has been seen by the river. You are sent to a medic near Blackwood Lake for more answers.

sections.title: A Second Camp
sections.body: At the front lines in the Eastern Plaguelands, Hailen's return is overdue. The Argent Dawn scout watches the outskirts and highlands, and usually comes back to camp every fortnight. From your description, the remains may be hers. Yet no other Skyborne like the one you saw has been seen by the river. A medic at another field camp may know more.

faq.answer: Hailen is an Argent Dawn scout assigned to the outskirts and highlands. She usually returns to camp every fortnight.
The Argent Dawn believes the remains you found may be Hailen's, based on your description.
Speak with the medic at the Argent Dawn field camp northwest of Blackwood Lake in the Eastern Plaguelands.

faq.q: Why am I speaking with the medic?
faq.answer: The medic at the other Argent Dawn field camp may know something about the remains and the Skyborne seen by the river.

faq.q: When does Hailen return to camp?
faq.answer: Hailen tends to return to camp every fortnight.

angles.text: As a Skyborne, you are told that the Argent Dawn has seen no others like the one you saw by the river.
